data.name: DrawingAsmeSizeRule
data.value: ASME: Rule #1 normally governs individual regular features of size. Feature M/L specify material condition; datum M/L specify material boundary.

data.name: DrawingPickOppositeSizeFace
data.value: Select the second original size face

data.name: DrawingPlanarSizeRequirements
data.value: Select two original planar faces on the same solid. Complete polygonal prism thickness or rectangular through-slot width must be proved; no diameter symbol is used for a median plane.

data.name: ExchangeMeasurementHint
data.value: Export and re-import with Cadoryx, then compare measured bounds, area, solid volume, hierarchy and color palette. The archive includes the actual files and report. External CAD and per-face style checks are separate.

data.name: SolidOffsetHint
data.value: Choose one whole solid. Positive distance expands it; negative distance shrinks it. Reselect face references on the result; source face colors are not carried across.

data.name: ContourCompletePick
data.value: Finish the explicit seed/support selection before previewing.

data.name: ContourLaw
data.value: Radius law over the whole chain

data.name: ContourLawHint
data.value: The normalized domain covers the entire discovered chain. All radii must stay positive. Parameter bindings retain program and row IDs; detach bindings before removing a driven row or changing its law family.

data.name: ContourOverlap
data.value: This native chain overlaps another program. Select a separate contour.

data.name: ContourPickSeed
data.value: Choose a source, then pick an exact edge. The complete native tangent chain receives this program.

data.name: ContourPickSupport
data.value: Pick an adjacent support face on the same source to set the chamfer direction.

data.name: ContourReselectHint
data.value: Select each affected program and explicitly reselect its current seed and support face.

data.name: FaceDefeatureHint
data.value: Choose all faces of the feature to remove. Confirm only after preview shows one complete healed solid.

data.name: FaceEditNormalPending
data.value: Choose a planar face to confirm its outward normal.

data.name: FacePushPullHint
data.value: Choose one planar face. Its complete finite region and holes are used. Positive distance adds outward; negative distance removes inward.

data.name: CircularContactHint
data.value: Select two curves in A, B order: a line segment and a circle/arc, or two circles/arcs. Choose the directed line side or external/containment branch. The contact must lie on every finite curve.

data.name: ContactBranchFailure
data.value: The selected contact branch cannot be verified. Check radii, circle centers and fixed constraints.

data.name: ContactInvalidTargets
data.value: Select exactly two line/circular curves and a matching contact branch.

data.name: ContactOutsideDomain
data.value: The supporting curves are tangent, but the contact lies outside the selected segment or arc. Adjust the finite curves.

data.name: RepetitionStyleConflict
data.value: Native contributors have conflicting presentation. Select whole-body presentation or change the layout.

data.name: RepetitionStyleEvidence
data.value: Styled source slots: {0}; copied result slots: {1}; shared contributors: {2}; conflicts: {3}.

data.name: RepetitionStyleHint
data.value: Conflicting colors, layers or materials in fused faces require an explicit whole-body choice. This choice omits subshape assignments.

data.name: RepetitionStyleUnsupported
data.value: The source presentation cannot be verified against the complete native map. Check the exact source and select whole-body presentation where appropriate.

data.name: EndpointCurvatureHint
data.value: Select exactly two line, arc, quadratic Bezier or clamped cubic curves with one shared endpoint ID. Tangents must oppose and signed curvature must match; cusp or degenerate derivatives are rejected.

data.name: CurvatureOutputFailure
data.value: Returned endpoint tangent or curvature is outside tolerance. Adjust fixed points or curve controls.

data.name: HoleThreadHint
data.value: Symbolic intent retains pitch and effective depth with a plain pilot hole. Disable clearance intent before choosing a thread.

data.name: HoleThreadModeledHint
data.value: Cuts a 60 degree groove with a flat root and the selected workshop pilot. Axial length is limited to 1–64 pitches. No tolerance-class compliance is implied.

data.name: FiniteContactHint
data.value: Select two curves, explicit interior parameters, direction and continuity. Copied exact curves remain fixed.

data.name: ExtrusionSurfaceSupport
data.value: Starting support of the exact target

data.name: ExtrusionSurfaceHint
data.value: Select the target starting support and a finite plane, sphere or cylinder. The complete profile must fit the support. Select the entry or exit branch; the finite stop must cover the complete terminal cap. A plane uses the near branch.

data.name: FiniteContactInvalidParameterOrder
data.value: Choose parameters strictly inside 0–1 and G1 or G2 continuity. Use endpoint relations at 0 or 1.

data.name: SlidingContactResult
data.value: Current A / B (automatic results are read-only)

data.name: SlidingContactHint
data.value: Automatic parameters stay strictly inside their explicit bounds. The initial value and bounds remain separate from the solved result.

data.name: SlidingContactInvalidInterval
data.value: The initial parameter and current value must be strictly inside valid bounds between 0 and 1.

data.name: SlidingContactInvalidMode
data.value: Select an explicit parameter mode and provide an initial value and bounds for each automatic parameter.

data.name: SlidingContactDriverConflict
data.value: This parameter has a fixed design driver. Detach that binding explicitly before switching it to automatic solving.

data.name: SlidingContactDerivativeAmbiguous
data.value: The required derivative is not proved at this knot or seam. Choose an unambiguous interior parameter.

data.name: LoopOffsetFailure
data.value: The selected boundary cannot be offset with this distance and corner join. Check closure, branches, collapse and intersections.

data.name: ExactOffsetHint
data.value: Select one source curve. The signed distance follows its directed right normal; construction mode creates a reference curve.

data.name: ExpressionSourceActive
data.value: Source linked; endpoints follow the solved curve.

data.name: ExpressionSourceFrozen
data.value: Source frozen; detach before editing its curve values.

data.name: AssociativeEndpointsHint
data.value: Select one expression and optionally two existing points in start/end order. Endpoints remain associated with the curve; they are not fixed anchors.

data.name: RegionSourceActive
data.value: Linked region with {0} segments. Distance, freeze, resume and detach apply to the whole group.

data.name: RegionSourceFrozen
data.value: Frozen region with {0} segments. Resume or detach the whole group before editing.

data.name: RegionFrozenReason
data.value: Region frozen explicitly in the sketch editor

data.name: RegionReselectHint
data.value: Explicitly choose a replacement for every source slot in every loop, in traversal order. Preview the complete mapping before applying.

data.name: RegionReselectIncomplete
data.value: Choose a replacement for every source slot before previewing.

data.name: RegionReselectStale
data.value: The sketch changed after this mapping was opened. Close and reopen source selection.

data.name: RegionReselectPending
data.value: Apply or discard the pending numeric edits before reselecting sources.

data.name: RegionReselectParameterGuard
data.value: Detach the region parameter drivers and references before changing its source structure.

data.name: RegionReselectIncompatible
data.value: The complete correspondence could not be proved. The original sketch is unchanged.

data.name: RegionReselectPreviewReady
data.value: Complete correspondence verified. Apply updates the draft in one undo step; confirm the sketch to update the document.

data.name: RegionReselectSuccess
data.value: Region sources updated in the draft. Preview and confirm the sketch to update the document.

data.name: RegionReselectPreviewOutdated
data.value: The mapping changed. The drawing shows the previous preview; preview again before applying.

data.name: AiEmptyResponseRetry
data.value: The model returned no text or tool call. Retrying once within the current limit.

data.name: MaterialSourceStylesHint
data.value: Imported face colors and textures remain until this option is enabled. An instance color override takes priority.

data.name: MaterialTextureTooLarge
data.value: The image exceeds the supported file or pixel budget.

data.name: MaterialTextureUnsupported
data.value: Choose a single PNG or JPEG image.

data.name: MaterialTextureEditExpired
data.value: The document or selected material changed. Import the texture again.

data.name: MaterialMappingPlanesHint
data.value: S and T define independent planes in part coordinates: X, Y, Z and offset D.

data.name: ViewportRecoveryDeadline
data.value: The replacement viewport did not become ready within 30 seconds.

data.name: AiTruncatedResponseRetry
data.value: The model response was cut off. Retrying once within the current limit, keeping completed actions.
